source_text: Stops a physical attack. Raise your anger 1 level.
engine_notes: defense.stops strike; op fervor +1
title_note: Wind veers the blow aside and keeps rising = stops a Strike, your Fervor up
notes: The school's clean Strike answer; today only storm_static_field stops a Strike and it is also an attack

source_text: Stops a physical attack. If you declared Tokui-Waza, stop your opponent's next physical attack in his next "Attacker Attacks!" phase.
engine_notes: defense.stops strike; op float what stop_next duration next_attack_phase
title_note: Charge earthed twice over = stops this Strike and their next one
notes: declared rider always on, so it reads as unconditional and the title takes both stops

source_text: Stops an opponent's physical attack. Lower opponent's anger 1 level.
engine_notes: defense.stops strike; op fervor who opponent -1
title_note: Damping the coil = stops a Strike and cools their Fervor
notes: Storm's first Fervor denial of any kind; printed as an Energy Combat card but it only stops a Strike, so it is filed as a Strike answer

source_text: Stops a physical attack. Place this card at the bottom of your Life Deck after use.
engine_notes: defense.stops strike; bottom_after_use
title_note: A front that turns the blow and comes around again = stop, then back under the deck
notes: One of only two non-Drill Non-Combats the printed Orange pool has

source_text: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped physical attack performed against you during Combat.
engine_notes: shield: "strike"
title_note: A standing charge-mantle = shield that takes the first Strike
notes: Storm's first Drill of any kind; also counts against the Strike-answer gap

source_text: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped energy attack performed against you during Combat.
engine_notes: shield: "art"
title_note: Charge spread across the coil = shield that takes the first Art
notes: Pairs with storm_mantle_drill as a two-Drill shield row

source_text: All of your energy attacks do +1 life card of damage. If you declared Toku-Waza, all of your energy attacks do +2 life cards of damage instead.
engine_notes: modifiers [{scope own, kind art, life 2}]
title_note: A tighter coil = every Art of yours does more damage
notes: declared rider always on, so the +2 branch is the printed effect; the standing Art damage floor Storm has never had

source_text: Allows the attacker to pay 1 stage instead of 2 on any energy attack.
engine_notes: art_cost_delta: -1 (as on storm_mastery)
title_note: An easier path for the charge = your Arts cost 1 stage less
notes: Stacks with Storm Mastery's own art_cost_delta, which is worth checking at deck-build time

source_text: Endurance 2. You can only use this card after you have taken 5 or more life cards of damage from 1 attack this Combat. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, search your discard pile for up to 3 Allies and place them in play at their highest power stage.
engine_notes: endurance 2; op search source discard card_type ally to play, amount 3, up_to. Missing: a `when` for "took 5+ wounds from one attack this Combat"
title_note: Thunder calling the company in = up to 3 Allies come back from the discard pile
notes: declared rider always on, so the Ally return is unconditional. The only other non-Drill Non-Combat in the printed Orange pool. Off-theme for Storm (Ally support) but it is the card that exists

source_text: Endurance 3. Take 1 or 2 of your opponent's Dragon Balls and place them at the bottom of his Life Deck.
engine_notes: endurance 3; op discard_in_play who opponent card_type seal amount 2 up_to choose. Missing: a `to: "deck_bottom"` destination on discard_in_play (defacement only removes)
title_note: Wind scatters what they carved = their Seals go back under their deck
notes: One of exactly two Combat cards the printed Orange pool has

source_text: Use when entering Combat. Reveal your hand to your opponent. If at least 3 cards in your hand are Orange Style Cards, attach this to your Main Personality. While attached, your Main Personality does not have to pay costs for any card effects.
engine_notes: attachment exists; missing a cost-waiver rule (nothing in the engine suspends printed costs) and a reveal-hand-and-count condition
title_note: Current running with nothing in its way = your card costs are waived
notes: Taken only because the Orange pool prints no other Combat card. Drop it if a `major` is unwanted

source_text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Stops an energy attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, gain 4 power stages. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
engine_notes: defense.stops art; op energy +4 target duelist; op fervor who opponent -1
title_note: Catching the charge instead of earthing it = stops an Art and fills your gauge
notes: declared rider always on, so the 4 stages come with every catch. Printed with a tournament-format gate ("Tuff Enuff Only") that has no parallel here and would simply be dropped

source_text: Physical attack. Your main personality gains 3 power stages. Remove the top card of your opponents discard pile from the game.
engine_notes: attack strike; op energy +3 target duelist; op remove_discard who opponent amount 1 from top
title_note: An arc that feeds the one who threw it = Strike, gain Energy, burn off their discard
notes: Energy gain on the attack rather than on a block, which storm_recharge does not cover

source_text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage. Raise your anger 1 level.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 3; trigger if_successful op energy "max" target duelist; op fervor +1
title_note: The stroke that runs back up the channel = a Strike that leaves you at full Energy
notes: Third Energy refill, and the only one riding a real Strike

source_text: Endurance 3. Physical attack. If successful, look at your opponent's hand and choose a Physical Combat card. Your opponent discards the chosen card, if any.
engine_notes: endurance 3; trigger if_successful op discard_hand who opponent amount 1 random false card_type strike
title_note: A squall wringing them out = Strike that takes a Strike answer from their hand
notes: Storm's first hand attack. Pulls a Strike answer specifically, so it is a beatdown enabler

source_text: Energy attack. Empower 3. All your other energy attacks do +1 life cards of damage for the remainder of Combat. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
engine_notes: empower 3; op float what modifier duration combat params {scope own, kind art, life 1}; op fervor who opponent -2
title_note: One peal makes the next louder = Art that raises the damage of your later Arts
notes: Fervor denial plus a mid-Combat Art floor; pairs naturally with storm_coil_drill

source_text: Energy attack doing 3 life cards of damage. Costs 0 power stages to perform.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 3 cost_stages 0
title_note: The spark off an idle coil = a free Art, and a small one
notes: The only free Art in the Orange pool; the answer to a dry gauge

source_text: Endurance 2. Energy attack. Costs 3 power stages to perform. If successful, and you declared a Tokui-Waza, your opponent discards a card from his hand.
engine_notes: endurance 2; attack art cost_stages 3; trigger if_successful op discard_hand who opponent amount 1
title_note: Charge penned up and let go = a costly Art that knocks a card from their hand
notes: declared rider always on, so the hand discard is unconditional. The expensive end of the cost band, against storm_idle_spark's free end

source_text: Focused physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, all energy attacks this personality performs for the remainder of Combat do +2 life cards of damage.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 2 focused; trigger if_successful op float what modifier duration combat params {scope own, kind art, life 2}
title_note: The first stroke opens the channel = Focused Strike that raises your later Arts
notes: A Strike that exists to make the Arts bigger, which is the shape storm_volley wants

source_text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Your opponent may not use Energy Combat cards to stop this attack.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 6 no_stop_by art
title_note: Nothing on their side left to earth it = an Art that Art cards cannot stop
notes: Not counted as a lockout: it is a property of this one attack, not a Combat-wide forbid

source_text: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. If successful, discard an opponent's Ally in play.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 4; trigger if_successful op discard_in_play who opponent card_type ally amount 1 choose
title_note: A gust that takes one of them off their feet = Strike that removes an Ally
notes: Board removal on a Strike, which Storm has only ever had on Arts

source_text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If stopped, your opponent must discard the top 2 cards of his Life Deck.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 6; trigger if_stopped op discard_life who opponent amount 2
title_note: Charge still in the ground after it earths = mills 2 even when stopped
notes: The 6-wound Art with a floor, against storm_lash's flat 5

source_text: Endurance 2. Focused physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, discard up to 4 of your opponent's Allies in play. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
engine_notes: endurance 2; attack strike stages 3 focused; trigger if_successful op discard_in_play who opponent card_type ally amount 4 up_to choose; op fervor who opponent -2
title_note: Wind flattening the whole stand = Strike that sweeps their Allies and cools them
notes: The late Ally sweep for the school; keep it out of early bundles

source_text: Endurance 3. Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. All of your other attacks do +1 power stages of damage for the remainder of Combat. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
engine_notes: endurance 3; attack strike stages 4; op float what modifier duration combat params {scope own, kind any, stages 1}; op fervor who opponent -2
title_note: A wind behind everything after it = Strike that raises all your later attacks
notes: Second card in the "first attack raises the rest" line with storm_opening_bolt

source_text: Energy attack. Lower opponent's anger 2 levels.
engine_notes: attack art; op fervor who opponent -2
title_note: A cold front moving over them = an Art that only takes their Fervor down
notes: The plain Fervor-denial Art, so a Storm deck can police an Ascension clock

source_text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Name a card that can perform a physical attack. Search your opponent's Life Deck for all copies of that card and discard them.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 5; op name_card exists (counterplay_drill). Missing: naming into a search of the OPPONENT's Life Deck that discards every copy
title_note: Static that hushes one signal = name a card, strip every copy from their deck
notes: Lockout by the naming rule, so late tier only. Also Storm's only reach into the opponent's deck

source_text: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped physical attack performed against you during Combat.
engine_notes: shield: "strike"
title_note: A planted hedgerow = shield that takes the first Strike
notes: Root's second Drill; the school currently has one

source_text: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped energy attack performed against you during Combat.
engine_notes: shield: "art"
title_note: The canopy catching what falls = shield that takes the first Art
notes: Pairs with root_windbreak_drill; between them the Seal deck survives a first exchange for free

source_text: When entering Combat, look at the top 2 cards of your Life Deck. You may place both cards either on top or on the bottom of your Life Deck in any order.
engine_notes: trigger entering_combat op look_at amount 2 rearrange from top. Missing: a choice of top or bottom for the whole look (look_at has `rest`, not an either-end choice)
title_note: A cleared sightline down the trail = look at your top 2 and order them
notes: Reads your own deck where root_preparation_drill reads theirs, so the two stack rather than repeat

source_text: Raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage. Draw a card and show it to your opponent. If that card is a Namekian Style card, choose 2 cards from your discard pile and place them on the bottom of your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: op energy "max" target duelist; op draw_check school root reveal, effects [op search source discard amount 2 to deck_bottom]; remove_after_use
title_note: Drinking the grove deep = full Energy, and spent cards back under the deck
notes: Ungated where root_energy_deflection and root_dragon_blast are Verdant only

source_text: Play this card immediately after taking damage from an attack. Your opponent discards the top 3 cards from his Life Deck.
engine_notes: trigger on_wound op discard_life who opponent amount 3
title_note: Thorns tearing at whoever cut through = they mill 3 after they wound you
notes: Uses the existing on_wound trigger rather than the use-when window README lists as not supported

source_text: Heroes only. Physical attack. If successful, also capture a Dragon Ball from your opponent. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. Remove from the game after use.
gap_filled: Non-Combats that place or fetch Seals (partial)
engine_notes: attack strike; trigger if_successful op capture_seal; op fervor who opponent -2; remove_after_use
title_note: Reaching across for their carving = Strike that takes a Seal and cools them
notes: Printed "Heroes only", so it would take alignment_only: vigil. Closest the Namekian pool gets to the Seal gap; no Namekian Non-Combat places or fetches one

source_text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 3
title_note: Standing timber coming down = a plain heavy Strike
notes: The workhorse Strike the school has none of; root has two Strike cards today and one is a stop

source_text: Physical attack doing 6 life cards of damage. Costs 3 power stages to perform.
engine_notes: attack strike printed_life 6 cost_stages 3
title_note: A millstone turning = a costly Strike that grinds into the Life Deck
notes: Life damage on a Strike, which Root only has on Arts

source_text: Physical attack. Place the bottom 2 cards from your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck.
engine_notes: attack strike; op search source discard amount 2 from bottom to deck_bottom
title_note: Sap drawing back up the trunk = Strike that returns spent cards to your deck
notes: Ungated recursion on an attack, so the Seal deck recycles while it pressures

source_text: Physical attack doing +2 life cards of damage. If successful, draw the top card from your discard pile. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: attack strike printed_life 2; trigger if_successful op draw_discard amount 1 from top; op fervor who opponent -2; remove_after_use
title_note: Pruning for regrowth = Strike that cools them and takes a card back from the discard
notes: Root's first Fervor card of either direction

source_text: Focused physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, choose any cards in your discard pile and remove them from the game.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 3 focused; trigger if_successful op remove_discard choose
title_note: Dead wood cleared off the floor = Focused Strike that removes discards from the game
notes: Root's only Focused Strike, which is how it goes around a Shield deck

source_text: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack stays on the table to be used 2 more times this Combat. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 3; remain 2; remove_after_use
title_note: A briar catching again and again = a Strike that remains for two more uses
notes: declared rider always on, so the Remain is unconditional. One card covering three attack phases; Root has no Remain card at all today

source_text: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. Gain 4 power stages. If performed against a Majin, this attack is a focused physical attack.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 5; op energy +4 target duelist; attack.variants [{when {defender_tag ...}, focused true}]
title_note: Sap quickening = the heaviest Strike, and it feeds your own gauge
notes: Biggest plain Strike in the Namekian pool, and it pays for the next Art

source_text: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful and you declared a Tokui-Waza, remove a Non-Combat card in play from the game.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 3; trigger if_successful op discard_in_play who opponent card_type non_combat amount 1 remove choose
title_note: A snare springing shut = Strike that removes a Non-Combat from the game
notes: declared rider always on, so the removal is unconditional. Removes rather than discards, so it beats recursion. Root has zero board removal today

source_text: Endurance 3. Physical attack. Empower 4. Discard one of your opponent's Non-Combat, Ally, or Battleground cards in play. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
engine_notes: endurance 3; empower 4; op discard_in_play who opponent card_type non_combat_or_ally amount 1 choose after_empower; op discard_grounds after_empower; op fervor who opponent -2
title_note: A wedge driven into what they built = breaks a Drill, an Ally or a Grounds
notes: The only Root card that can answer a Grounds; pairs with root_snare

source_text: Physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack does 6 power stages of damage and raises your anger 1 level. Unless your Main Personality is Pikkon, remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: attack strike stages 6; op fervor +1; remove_after_use
title_note: The grove's temper coming up = a 6-stage Strike that raises your Fervor
notes: declared rider always on, so it always does 6 stages and always raises Fervor. Root's only Fervor gain, which its Aspect-4-and-5 duelist wants. The character clause on the removal simply becomes an unconditional remove_after_use

source_text: Endurance 2. Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If you declared a Tokui-Waza, shuffle the top 2 cards of your discard pile back into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: endurance 2; attack strike stages 3; op shuffle_discard amount 2; remove_after_use
title_note: Bindweed holding them fast = Endurance Strike that shuffles growth back into your deck
notes: declared rider always on, so the recursion is unconditional. Endurance plus recursion on one card, which is the whole Root survival plan

source_text: Stops a physical attack. Gain 3 power stages.
engine_notes: defense.stops strike; op energy +3 target duelist
title_note: Sapwood taking the blow = stops a Strike and draws Energy up
notes: The Strike-side twin of root_energy_catch, which does the same for Arts

source_text: (Tuff Enuff Only) Stops a physical attack. If you declared a Tokui-Waza power up to full. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
engine_notes: defense.stops strike; op energy "max" target duelist; op fervor who opponent -1
title_note: Bracing on the taproot = stops a Strike and pulls you to full Energy
notes: declared rider always on, so the power-up to full comes with every block. Printed with a tournament-format gate that has no parallel here and would be dropped

source_text: Stops the next physical attack or energy attack performed against you this Combat. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: defense.stops "any"; remove_after_use
title_note: A bough barred across the trail = stops the next attack of either kind
notes: The only universal stop in the whole printed Namekian pool; the gap asks for 2. Title carries a character's name in the source and is dropped

source_text: Endurance 10. Shuffle the top card of your discard pile back into your Life Deck. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: endurance 10; op shuffle_discard amount 1; remove_after_use
title_note: Bark closing over a wound = heavy Endurance, and one card back into the deck
notes: Endurance 10 is the largest in the set; this is Root's answer to one big hit

source_text: Endurance 4. Look at the top 4 cards of your opponent's Life Deck. Remove 1 non-Dragon Ball card from the game and put the rest back in any order on top of the Life Deck.
engine_notes: endurance 4; op look_at amount 4 role opposing rearrange. Missing: a `to: "removed"` pick out of another player's look_at (look_at picks to hand or play today)
title_note: One thing cut out of the path ahead = look at their top 4 and remove one
notes: Reaches into the opponent's deck, which no Root card does. The Seal exception in the printed text maps to Seals here

source_text: You must have an Ally in play to use this card. Discard all of your opponents' Non-Combat cards in play. Limit 1 per deck.
engine_notes: when {ally_present}; op discard_in_play who opponent card_type non_combat all; remove_after_use; limit_per_deck 1
title_note: Kin standing in a cleared glade = with an Ally out, every Non-Combat of theirs goes
notes: Printed limit 1 and needs company on the table, so it is a late-tier card for an Ally-leaning Root deck

source_text: Energy attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
engine_notes: attack art; op fervor who opponent -1
title_note: A thin early frost = the cheapest Art, and it takes their Fervor down
notes: The plain Fervor-denial Art, and the cheapest attack Root can make

source_text: Focused energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 5 focused; op fervor who opponent -2
title_note: A splinter boring straight through = Focused Art that chills them
notes: Root's only Focused Art; it goes around Shields and Masteries

source_text: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage. If successful, discard a Non-Combat card in play. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 5; trigger if_successful op discard_in_play who opponent card_type non_combat amount 1 choose; remove_after_use
title_note: A hurled stone = an Art that also knocks over a Non-Combat
notes: Board removal on an Art, where root_snare is the Strike version

source_text: Energy attack doing 6 life cards of damage. If successful, place the bottom 3 cards of your discard pile at the bottom of your Life Deck. If stopped, remove the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile from the game.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 6; trigger if_successful op search source discard amount 3 from bottom to deck_bottom; trigger if_stopped op remove_discard amount 2 from bottom
title_note: Seed thrown wide = lands and regrows your discard, stopped and the seed is lost
notes: Pays whether it lands or not, which suits a deck that plans to be blocked

source_text: Energy attack doing 10 life cards of damage. Costs 4 power stages to perform. If successful, remove the top 3 cards of your Life Deck from the game. If this attack is stopped, discard your hand. Remove from the game after use.
engine_notes: attack art printed_life 10 cost_stages 4; trigger if_successful op remove_discard-style removal of own top 3 (op discard_life with remove) ; trigger if_stopped op discard_hand amount all; remove_after_use
title_note: The oldest wood in the grove = a 10-wound Art that costs the grove to call on
notes: A 10-wound finisher that can empty your own hand; late tier only

source_text: Endurance 2. Energy attack. If succesful, discard one of your opponent's Allies in play. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
engine_notes: endurance 2; attack art; trigger if_successful op discard_in_play who opponent card_type ally amount 1 choose; op fervor who opponent -1
title_note: A killing frost = an Art that culls one of their Allies
notes: Root's only answer to an Ally deck
